# Results summary (generated by analyze.py)

P_s = fraction of conflict test points classified by the simple feature (1 = always simple, 0 = always complex). gap = log2(T_c / T_s), where T is the median number of SGD steps to 95% train accuracy when only that feature is predictive. gap > 0 means the complex feature is slower to learn in isolation.

## Indifference points (gap* where P_s = 0.5)

Fit: P_s = sigmoid(b * (gap - gap*)) by least squares on seed-level values, using only valid cells (both isolated runs reached 95% train accuracy and >= 95% test accuracy). CI: 500 bootstrap resamples of seeds within cells, resampling both the joint runs (P_s) and the isolated runs (gap). 'bracketed' = valid cells exist on both sides of P_s = 0.5.
